title: TUEL Blueprint Manifest
description: Schema for blueprint.yaml, the manifest at the root of every TUEL blueprint folder. tools/lint.py validates manifests against this file and additionally enforces file-level rules the schema cannot express (files exist, slug matches directory, CLAUDE.md hard rules). The manifest is a repository convention: Claude Desktop does not read it.

slug.description: Lowercase identifier. Must equal the blueprint directory name. The scaffold under templates/_blank uses the placeholder slug '_blank', accepted only there.

version.description: Semantic version. Bump minor for workflow/skill changes, major for changes to approval rules or memory layout. Never silently change an installed owner's approval policy in an upgrade.

business_type.description: Plain description of the business this blueprint operates, e.g. 'barber & beauty salon'.

summary.description: One sentence an owner would understand, shown in the catalog.

skills.description: Each entry must have a matching skills/<slug>/SKILL.md.

schedules.description: Each entry must have a matching schedules/<slug>.md. Morning brief and end-of-day close are the required minimum.

workflows.description: Each entry must have a matching workflows/<slug>.md.

templates.description: Each entry must have a matching templates/<slug>.md.

memory_files.description: Business-memory stubs. Required: a blueprint without business memory has no source of truth. Each entry must have a matching business/<slug>.md. Owner-owned: ships as empty friendly stubs, never with fabricated data.

name.description: Tool the owner may connect, e.g. 'Gmail', 'Square'.

why.description: Plain-English reason an owner would connect it. No jargon.

status.description: Recommendation label. A recommendation never claims installation, authorization, or compliance.

connectors.description: Optional recommendations, mirrored in owner-facing connectors.md. All connections are optional; the blueprint must work with none.
